title: Open these in the tracker? — 4 suggestions

payload.intro:
From the **audit of `acme/checkout`** (commit `4f1a9c2`). Each item below would be filed in the tracker as written. Reject with a reason and the agent files none of it.

> Nothing is filed until you hand over.

items.title: Refund rounds the wrong way on split payments
items.body:
`Checkout.Refund.split/2` divides with `Float.round/2` before it allocates the remainder, so a refund of a 3-way split is a cent short.

### Where

| file | line | note |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `lib/checkout/refund.ex` | 88 | rounds each share |
| `lib/checkout/refund.ex` | 96 | sums the rounded shares |

### Reproducing it

```elixir
iex> Checkout.Refund.split(Money.new(1000), 3)
[%Money{amount: 333}, %Money{amount: 333}, %Money{amount: 333}]
# 999, not 1000
```

The fix is to allocate the remainder to the first shares, as `Money.allocate/2` already does.

items.title: Webhook replay window is 10 minutes, the provider's is 5
items.body:
A replayed webhook is accepted for five minutes longer than the provider signs for.

1. The provider signs a timestamp
2. We compare it against `@replay_window`
3. `@replay_window` is `600`, the documented window is `300`

See the [provider's signature docs](https://example.com/docs/webhooks#verify). Not exploitable on its own — it widens the window for one that is.

items.title: Two modules parse the same CSV shape
items.body:
`Checkout.Import.Legacy` and `Checkout.Import.V2` both carry a parser for the same export, and they disagree about empty cells:

- **Legacy** reads `""` as `nil`
- **V2** reads `""` as `""`
  - which makes `Enum.reject(&is_nil/1)` a no-op downstream

One parser, one answer. Nothing calls Legacy since the March migration.
